newsitem.title: BULGARIA: IMF mission leader delays Sofia visit by one day.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission leader delays Sofia visit by one day.

text.p: Mission leader of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) team Anne McGuirk, due in Bulgaria this week to evaluate reform progress, postponed her arrival until Friday, the IMF office said on Thursday.

The mission, part of which already arrived, is expected to review Bulgaria's progress in strengthening financial discipline and agree on reform policies that would release a crucial second $115 million tranche.
On Tuesday Prime Minister Zhan Videnov said Bulgaria's failure to meet macroeconomic targets may clog funding talks with the Fund.
